provenance: The sync_commit identifies the committed implementation snapshot. Exact function and covered-module fingerprints remain the source/model synchronization checks.

mapping.Prepare: Store.prepare_release; valid source snapshots/layout abstracted, no activation
mapping.Begin: Store._activate confirmation/prepared/history guards; ReleaseAuthority/apply_release additionally check signed scope, baseline, policy and trial for gated releases
mapping.BuildSealedCopy: Store._create_deployment reads hash-checked snapshot blobs into a fresh private generation and removes ordinary write permissions; prepared cache is not deployed
mapping.RecordIntent: Store._activate commits activation_requested and consumed grant ID atomically in SQLite; no active selection changes yet
mapping.PublishPointer: Store._switch_pointer atomic os.replace is the selection commit point; apply_release revalidates evidence before publication
mapping.FinishHistory: Store._finish_activation projects selected receipt into active/history exactly once; reconcile_active repairs lag after publication
mapping.CrashOrAbort: Prepublication interruption leaves old selection; postpublication interruption leaves the new selection with audit recovery pending
mapping.ChangePrepared: External direct writes to packages/<snapshot>; no effect on newly copied and sealed deployments/<generation>/package
mapping.ReceiveProtectedEvaluation: ReleaseAuthority.evaluation verifies trusted signer, reproducible acceptance result, approved thresholds, actual skill loading, exact snapshot scope and versions
mapping.ReceiveGrant: ReleaseAuthority.grant verifies independent policy signer, expiry, nonce, evaluation hash, baseline/candidate and phase; private signer possession and policy protection are assumptions, not model proofs
mapping.ExpireGrant: ReleaseAuthority.envelope and revalidation reject stale authorizations; no automatic renewal
mapping.ObserveSuccessfulTrial: ReleaseAuthority.trial_identity/trial bind observed interval and matching trial, declared minimum duration/count, passed checks, zero critical violations and rollback evidence
mapping.OfflineEligibility: evaluate.review eligibility alone does not imply protected acceptance or authorization
mapping.NeverMislabelVerified: Manual path always unverified; true is supplied only through apply_release after independently signed evaluation, policy grant and monitored-trial verification
mapping.FailureRollback: stop_trial restores only the signed active trial baseline on explicit authenticated failure; projected by the valid rollback transition
mapping.Transaction atomicity: Store.transaction uses BEGIN IMMEDIATE and commit/rollback; DB history is a recoverable projection, not an atomic transaction with the filesystem
mapping.Automatic phase selection: advance_update serializes decisions under Store.release_lock and calls existing signed trial/promotion/failure-rollback gates. Preparing snapshots cannot select them; missing evidence defers. Model calls and budget allocation are outside this function.
mapping.Concrete semantic checks: Procedure path/content is resolved by existing skill ID before requiring a version increase; external evaluation envelopes are type checked before field access. Regression tests and the pstack diagnostic cover these concrete semantics; the finite TLA+ model abstracts manifests and JSON shapes.

assumptions: Fresh private sealed generation files are not subject to malicious same-account chmod/replacement; ordinary external prepared-folder writes remain modeled
Policy and signer private keys are protected by the host outside learner write/read capability respectively
Attested outcome/evaluator facts are honest; signatures establish provenance, not the truth of subjective judgments
Bounded two-release reachability is not unconditional eventual progress or unbounded implementation refinement
